name: Piedrahíta (Spain)
description: Square flag divided vertically, a black hoist third and a green fly, charged at the centre with the full achievement of the arms of Piedrahíta (quartered with crows and trees, with helm, mantling and motto).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 13 October 2000 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 82 of 27 April 2001); the arms of the town, inscribed Muy noble y leal Villa de Piedrahíta, are placed at the heart of the flag.

features.role: Piedrahíta arms — quartered with crows and trees, helm, mantling and motto
